maintainexSourceFindings.finding: Profile-backed search with broader placeholder; displayed shortcut has no listener in this component.
Unauthenticated non-auth pages redirect to login.
URL-backed filters, repeated filter surfaces, card-based list/grid arrangement.
Start Quest links to Coming Soon.
Quest and UserQuest exist; Collection is summary metadata; no ordered track membership or quest-to-work evidence relation.
Inspected coach and planning methods use deterministic rules and text output.
Existing work detail contains planning context but emphasizes extensive metadata first.
Charts use selected range while metric-card inputs use all activities.
Contribution award logic can prioritize title keywords; competitive expansion needs stronger evidence semantics.

limits: Curated route inventory rather than exhaustive crawl
No account creation or authenticated progress persistence tests
No premium entitlement or payment tests
No performance benchmark or comprehensive accessibility audit
No complete Deep-ML application source review
Maintainex comparison is code-based, without verifying production inventory
Robots and sitemap retrieval were unavailable through the web tool
